reply_text:
I posted the draft bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, Sofia. Nothing has gone to June.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026, and the CRM code moved from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so a PHL filter returns both accounts. Use the full name in subject lines and dropdowns.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs the new name.
- The Pemberline Dock export and an older shared-folder copy still had the old Covey & Lark header.

I did not create a mail draft for June. Say the word and I can save one in your mailbox.
